assessment.nobel_worthiness: Circuit QED made coherent light-matter interaction controllable on a chip, opening an experimentally powerful regime of quantum physics.
assessment.attribution: Blais and Girvin supplied decisive theoretical architecture, while Schoelkopf led foundational experimental realization; the proposed trio captures this complementarity.
assessment.maturity: The principles have been reproduced widely and underpin a large, mature experimental field.
uncertainties: Andreas Wallraff also has a major claim to early experimental credit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum error correction established that fragile quantum systems can in principle support reliable computation, a fundamental conceptual breakthrough.
assessment.attribution: Shor, Steane and Kitaev made distinct foundational contributions to codes, fault tolerance and topological protection.
assessment.maturity: The framework is secure and experimentally influential, although large-scale fault-tolerant computation remains unrealized.
uncertainties: Credit is unusually distributed across many code and threshold contributions.
The decisive technological demonstration is still ahead.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Trapped-ion quantum-information proposals and experiments turned entanglement control into a precise, scalable physical platform.
assessment.attribution: Cirac and Zoller provided seminal architectures and protocols, with Blatt furnishing defining experimental realizations.
assessment.maturity: The work has endured for decades, been independently reproduced, and supports both computation and precision science.
uncertainties: The scope overlaps with broader quantum-computing recognition and other platform pioneers.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Squeezed states converted a nonclassical quantum-optics resource into demonstrably improved measurement sensitivity.
assessment.attribution: Caves articulated the quantum limit and squeezing advantage; Kimble and Mavalvala represent essential experimental development and precision-measurement use.
assessment.maturity: Squeezing is a robust laboratory tool with conspicuous application in gravitational-wave observatories.
uncertainties: Experimental credit extends substantially beyond three individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks achieved an exceptional synthesis of quantum control and precision, transforming time and frequency metrology.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye are the clearly identifiable independent leaders of the lattice-clock concept and its realization.
assessment.maturity: Accuracy, reproducibility and broad adoption are established; the clocks enable stringent fundamental and geodetic tests.
uncertainties: Further agreement on the most appropriate route to redefining the second may affect timing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Control of individual NV spins made a solid-state defect into a sensitive quantum probe, with remarkable reach from nanoscale magnetism to biology.
assessment.attribution: Wrachtrup and Jelezko established key single-defect control experiments; Lukin made major foundational contributions to solid-state quantum optics.
assessment.maturity: Single-NV sensing is well reproduced and widely deployed across laboratories.
uncertainties: The discovery lineage and division between spin control, sensing and related colour-centre work are broad.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Aharonov-Bohm effect and geometric phase revealed that quantum phases and potentials have direct physical consequences beyond classical intuition.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov is central to the phase-effect discovery and Berry to the general geometric formulation; both contributions have distinct enduring identities.
assessment.maturity: The effects are foundational, repeatedly confirmed, and influential across quantum physics and condensed matter.
uncertainties: These are related but historically separate discoveries, making a single joint citation potentially less focused.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cavity optomechanics brought mechanical motion into the quantum-control domain and enabled tests of quantum measurement at mesoscopic scales.
assessment.attribution: Aspelmeyer, Kippenberg and Cleland are leading figures spanning the central experimental and conceptual developments.
assessment.maturity: Quantum optomechanical effects are reproducible and technically sophisticated, with a substantial international field.
uncertainties: It remains unclear whether the field has a single sufficiently delimited discovery for a prize.
